attempts.summary: Built an IKEv2 IPsec site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) across a dedicated transit network (10.99.0.0/30), carrying node3's lan-a (10.50.10.0/24) and node4's lan-b (10.50.20.0/24) subnets so node3 and node4 reach each other by private address with traffic encrypted in transit. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, each recovering fully (tunnel and connectivity restored automatically) with proven boot-identity change.
